places.name: Bookends Preloved Bookshop
places.description: The UAE's largest marketplace for second-hand books: shelves of preloved novels, children's books and non-fiction at low prices, and you can sell or swap your own books. Shop online or visit one of their stores.

places.name: Fun World Boats
places.description: Self-drive small electric boats on the lakes at Al Majaz Waterfront and Al Qasba in Sharjah, no licence needed. Best at sunset or after dark when the waterfront lights up; open late afternoon until about 1am.
